title: Salt Road Almanac
author: Ines Varga
blurb: A tide-table clerk in a fishing town notices that every drowning matches an almanac entry nobody wrote.

title: The Lantern Clerk
author: Odile Marsh
blurb: In a city that taxes light, a junior clerk discovers the ledger is quietly dimming the streets.

title: Small Hours at Birch Street
author: Tomas Reyes
blurb: One night, six apartments, and the dropped casserole that finally gets the building talking.

title: Orbit of Apricots
author: Mei-Lin Okafor
blurb: A cargo hauler's cook keeps a failing crew together with a stubborn orchard in cargo bay three.

title: The Cartographer's Apprentice
author: Willem Dahl
blurb: Fourteen-year-old Pell inherits a half-finished map of a continent that keeps rearranging itself.

title: Quiet Machines
author: Hana Lindqvist
blurb: A retired repair technician adopts a maintenance robot that has started to hum lullabies.

title: A Recipe for Ordinary Days
author: Priya Nandakumar
blurb: A daughter cooks through her late mother's handwritten notebook and meets the woman behind the margins.

title: The Ninth Lighthouse
author: Gareth Bloom
blurb: An inspector rows out to a lighthouse that is not on any chart and finds the keeper's table still set.

title: Pocket Guide to Dragons, Revised
author: Sunniva Aas
blurb: A deadpan field manual by a retired dragon surveyor who is wrong about almost everything.

title: The Glass Orchard Heist
author: Lucia Ferreira
blurb: Five botanists plan to steal a single extinct apple tree from a guarded conservatory.

title: Letters to the Night Ferry
author: Aaron Whitlock
blurb: Two strangers trade letters through a wartime ferry post and neither is who they claim to be.

title: Seven Minutes of Weather
author: Noor Haddad
blurb: Essays on how forecasting really works, written by a former radio meteorologist.

title: The Long Way Round to Lisbon
author: Fiona McAllister
blurb: A travel writer refuses to fly and takes eleven trains, two ferries, and one goat cart.

title: Moss and Circuitry
author: Dev Anand Rao
blurb: Engineers and gardeners share a failing arcology and slowly learn each other's language.

title: The Baker of Little Ashford
author: Margaret Oyelaran
blurb: A burnt-out lawyer inherits a village bakery and a feud over who invented the sticky bun.

title: Whistle Down the Wire
author: Callum Rhys
blurb: A telephone engineer realises the hum on a Berlin line is someone counting.
